independence.note: Read DESIRED_STATE only for cross_field, own newest role-local checkpoint, attempted only own sanitized feedback, and public sources.

search_bias: optimization/OR/control/information theory/distributed systems/scientific discovery; prioritize quantitative mechanisms with explicit failure regimes and safe fallback behavior

checked_sources.source: Tianyi Ma, Hanzhang Qin, Ruihao Zhu, Jierui Zuo, Best-Arm Identification with Generative Proxy, arXiv:2607.06879, 2026
checked_sources.result: Studies fixed-confidence best-arm identification where every expensive reward pull is paired with a cheap proxy whose reward correlation rho is unknown and must be learned online. A naive plug-in residual-variance estimate is anti-conservative and can break correctness. PROBE maintains a valid upper certificate on residual variance using OLS and an exact chi-square law; it is delta-PAC and matches the known-correlation oracle sample complexity up to a constant multiplicative factor and additive calibration cost. The oracle gain scales with residual variance 1-rho^2, so weak proxies naturally provide little benefit instead of being assumed useful. Primary abstract states synthetic and auto-loan replay experiments confirm sample savings scale with correlation strength.

checked_sources.source: Hamza Cherkaoui, Helene Halconruy, Yohan Petetin, Adaptive Sample Sharing for Linear Regression, arXiv:2510.16986, 2025
checked_sources.result: Introduces a target-focused, data-driven rule deciding how many source samples to borrow for ridge regression. The method estimates transfer gain and has finite-sample guarantees: under stated conditions it borrows source samples when they improve target parameter estimation and abstains otherwise. Synthetic and real-data experiments report consistent gains over strong baselines and single-task training while avoiding negative transfer. This is a direct template for source admission by conservative estimated gain rather than source similarity alone.

checked_sources.source: Elynn Chen, Xi Chen, Yi Zhang, Transfer Learning for Contextual Joint Assortment-Pricing under Cross-Market Heterogeneity, arXiv:2603.18114, 2026
checked_sources.result: Sequential online transfer under sparse cross-market utility shifts. TJAP aggregates source data to reduce variance, then uses target-only l1 debiasing for shifted coordinates and UCB confidence bounds with separate statistical-uncertainty and transfer-bias radii. Regret is order tilde-O(d*sqrt(T/(1+H)) + s0*sqrt(T)), making the variance/bias tradeoff explicit: source markets accelerate shared directions, while target-specific heterogeneity imposes adaptation cost. Numerical experiments reported by the primary source outperform both target-only learning and naive pooling under tested structured heterogeneity, but this is not a universal no-worse-than-target-only guarantee when heterogeneity is diffuse.

checked_sources.source: Michael Pearce, Matthias Poloczek, Juergen Branke, Bayesian Optimization Allowing for Common Random Numbers, Operations Research 70(6), 2022
checked_sources.result: KG-CRN models stochastic objective realizations by seed and jointly chooses both design x and whether to reuse an old random seed or query a new one. The paper reports significant empirical performance improvements with moderate added computational cost. The mechanism avoids fixing an arbitrary replication count in advance and turns scenario reuse versus scenario diversification into the acquisition decision itself.

checked_sources.source: Michael Pearce, Bayesian Optimization Allowing for Common Random Numbers (author technical blog)
checked_sources.result: Author explanation reports roughly 10-20% computational overhead versus standard KG in the tested implementation. It also describes two qualitatively different regimes: restocking, where a single seed is mostly an offset and heavy seed reuse works well, versus ambulance placement, where optimizing one realization does not reliably optimize the infinite-seed average. This motivates a guardrail that seed reuse must remain acquisition-driven and capable of returning to new scenarios when scenario-specific optimizer shifts are material.

checked_sources.source: Robust angle-based transfer learning in high dimensions, JRSSB 87(3), 2025
checked_sources.result: Provides an adjacent supervised-learning safety result: under the paper's high-dimensional linear model, optimized angle-based transfer has limiting predictive risk no worse than the target-only estimator even for distant/noisy source estimates. This shows that a transfer family can be constructed so target-only is structurally contained as a safe limit, but it is not an online sequential evidence-allocation result.

candidates_new.mechanism: When a cheap proxy or heuristic score is paired with expensive ground-truth evaluations, learn proxy usefulness online from the same paired observations but never use a naive plug-in variance reduction estimate. Maintain an upper confidence certificate on residual variance and allocate expensive evaluations according to that certificate. A weak proxy automatically yields little or no sample reduction; a strongly correlated proxy reduces ground-truth evaluation demand.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: For a proxy with reward correlation rho, the known-correlation oracle sample complexity improves according to residual variance 1-rho^2. PROBE learns unknown rho online yet is delta-PAC and reaches the oracle complexity up to a constant multiplicative factor plus a constant additive calibration cost. The primary paper reports synthetic and auto-loan replay experiments whose savings scale with correlation strength. A secondary review reports up to 61% stopping-time reduction in the auto-loan replay, but that exact percentage is not treated as primary-verified in this checkpoint.
candidates_new.operational_observable: For every proxy/evaluator pair, track paired-sample count, estimated residual variance, a statistically valid upper certificate on residual variance, observed reward-proxy correlation, decision gap, and actual expensive-sample savings versus a reward-only shadow path. Keep correctness criteria tied to the certified residual bound rather than raw proxy confidence.
candidates_new.scope: Fixed-confidence best-arm identification with paired proxy/reward observations and assumptions supporting the OLS/chi-square residual certificate. Not a generic guarantee for arbitrary biased proxies or non-paired black-box evaluators.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Naive plug-in residual variance is anti-conservative and can violate correctness. Benefit disappears as |rho| approaches zero. The method assumes the proxy marginal mean is cheaply estimable and that model conditions for the residual certificate hold; misspecification requires separate treatment.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Research systems can use cheap model-judges, simulations, synthetic evaluators, or LLM proxies to reduce expensive real evaluations if proxy value is itself treated as an online-estimated quantity with a conservative variance certificate. This is safer than trusting proxy benchmark correlation measured once offline.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain theory, medium-high for transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: Treat target-only learning as the safe baseline. Estimate the marginal target benefit of adding source evidence, include uncertainty in that gain estimate, and borrow only the amount of source data whose conservative estimated gain is nonnegative; otherwise abstain and stay target-only.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: The source gives finite-sample guarantees under stated conditions that the procedure borrows when source samples improve target parameter estimation and abstains otherwise. Experiments on synthetic and real regression datasets report consistent gains over strong baselines and single-task training while avoiding negative transfer. Exact headline percentage gains were not extracted from primary non-PDF text in this run, so no fabricated speedup factor is attached.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Maintain a target-only held-out/validation estimate, estimated transfer gain for each source amount, uncertainty on that gain, selected source amount, and post-transfer target error. Admission requires the lower confidence side of estimated transfer gain to be nonnegative.
candidates_new.scope: Ridge/linear regression with the paper's finite-sample assumptions and a small target validation/calibration split. Does not by itself solve sequential bandit regret or multi-source combinatorial selection.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Requires calibration/validation target data and accurate enough gain/variance estimation. Overly optimistic gain uncertainty would reintroduce negative transfer; excessively conservative bounds can waste useful source data.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Historical experiments, external replications, prior model generations, or proxy datasets should enter a current research decision only when a target-grounded conservative estimate certifies positive marginal value, with the amount of reused evidence selected adaptively rather than all-or-nothing.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain result, medium-high for transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: Pool source environments only to estimate shared directions; then use current-target observations to estimate and correct sparse source-target shifts. Keep statistical uncertainty and transfer-bias uncertainty as separate confidence components, and invoke additional target exploration only when target identifiability is insufficient.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: TJAP obtains regret order tilde-O(d*sqrt(T/(1+H)) + s0*sqrt(T)); the first term improves with source count H, while sparse target-specific shift contributes s0*sqrt(T). Primary experiments report monotone improvement with more source markets and superiority to target-only and naive pooling in tested structured-heterogeneity instances.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Track source-pooled uncertainty, target-only correction magnitude/support, transfer-bias radius, target Fisher-information/identifiability, and regret or decision loss versus both target-only and naive pooling shadows.
candidates_new.scope: Contextual joint assortment-pricing under MNL demand and sparse cross-market utility shifts. Transfer advantage diminishes as heterogeneity becomes diffuse; the theorem does not imply universal no-worse-than-target-only behavior outside the structural assumptions.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Diffuse or non-sparse heterogeneity makes the adaptation term large and can erase transfer gain. Naive pooling without debiasing is explicitly unsafe under structural heterogeneity. Target exploration remains necessary to identify shifted components.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: For research reuse across related tasks, separate 'shared transferable structure' from 'current-task correction' rather than blending all evidence into one estimator. Maintain explicit uncertainty budgets for variance reduction and transfer bias.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain theorem, medium for broad transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: When evaluations are stochastic and the random scenario/seed is controllable, let the acquisition function jointly choose the candidate and whether to reuse a previously seen scenario or sample a new one. Reuse can sharply improve pairwise discrimination when scenario effects are mostly common offsets; new scenarios are required when scenario-specific optima differ.
candidates_new.quantitative_evidence: The peer-reviewed paper reports significant empirical improvements with moderate computational overhead. The authors' implementation note reports about 10-20% overhead versus standard KG while allowing the optimizer to decide seed reuse. The author-reported applications exhibit both a high-reuse regime and a regime where one realization is not representative of the across-seed optimum.
candidates_new.operational_observable: Track old-seed reuse frequency, number of unique scenarios, posterior scenario-offset versus optimizer-shift variance, held-out across-seed objective, and marginal acquisition value of reusing each old scenario versus drawing a new one.
candidates_new.scope: Stochastic BO/simulation optimization where random seeds/scenarios can be explicitly controlled and modeled. Not appropriate when evaluation noise cannot be paired or seed identity is unavailable.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Over-reusing a scenario is harmful when seed/scenario changes the optimizer rather than mostly shifting outcomes by a common offset. The acquisition must retain a live new-seed option; fixed CRN reuse is not supported as a universal rule.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Research evaluation can reduce variance and cost by intentionally reusing the same benchmark seeds, environments, or test cases for close candidate comparisons, but must dynamically buy new scenarios when evidence suggests scenario-specific ranking changes.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source-domain mechanism, medium-high for transfer

evidence_updates.update: The critical unknown-bias dependency now has two adjacent operational patterns: conservative target-gain admission (Triple-S) and online proxy-quality certification (PROBE). Neither exactly estimates LUCB-H's source-target reward-bias bound in its original bandit setting, so the exact frontier remains open; however, both show how to avoid treating an estimated transfer benefit as certain.

KG-CRN adds a sequential design layer above covariance-aware comparison: it chooses whether the next evaluation should reuse a common scenario or introduce a new scenario. This suggests scenario identity itself should be a budgeted acquisition variable, with a guard against over-reuse when scenario-specific optima move.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: The exact online source-target bias bound in LUCB-H can already be learned without any extra structural assumptions while preserving a target-only guarantee
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: No qualifying primary result was recovered in this pass. PROBE learns reward-proxy correlation safely, Triple-S estimates conservative target transfer gain with validation, and TJAP learns sparse target corrections, but each changes the problem assumptions relative to LUCB-H's unknown bias-bound setting.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Keep the impossibility boundary from the prior checkpoint intact; do not claim the unknown-bias problem is solved in full generality.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A high offline proxy correlation can be plugged directly into evaluation allocation
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: PROBE explicitly identifies naive plug-in residual variance as anti-conservative; correctness requires an upper certificate learned from paired ground-truth samples.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Proxy usefulness must carry its own uncertainty certificate.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: Common random numbers should always reuse the same seed once correlation is positive
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: KG-CRN's design keeps new-seed sampling as an explicit acquisition option, and the authors report an application where optimizing a single realization does not optimize the infinite-seed average.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Use adaptive reuse/new-scenario choice, not permanent seed locking.

frontier: Find a sequential transfer/bandit method that estimates source-target bias magnitude online from target observations and provides a strict finite-sample no-worse-than-target-only guarantee under deliberately misspecified or adversarial source data; extract exact degradation when its structural assumptions fail.

Primary-verify the auto-loan stopping-time reduction reported for PROBE and extract the exact proxy correlations, baseline stopping times, calibration cost, and misspecification experiments from primary text rather than a secondary review.

Find a direct automatic safe-transfer Bayesian-optimization method with an implemented target-only shadow/fallback and adversarial source tasks; require matched time-to-best/regret against both naive transfer and target-only BO.
Quantify KG-CRN or a successor on tasks where scenario-specific optimizer shifts vary continuously; identify an operational statistic for when to stop reusing old seeds and buy new scenarios.
Find finite-budget covariance-aware ranking/selection under non-Gaussian or heavy-tailed correlated observations to unify common-scenario and heavy-tail guardrails.

actions_taken_instead_of_stopping: Pursued the unknown-bias safe-transfer frontier and found two adjacent mechanisms that estimate transfer/proxy value conservatively instead of assuming it: Triple-S and PROBE.
Continued into sequential cross-market transfer and recovered TJAP's explicit split between pooled statistical uncertainty and target-specific transfer-bias correction.
Moved to the fallback common-random-number BO branch and recovered KG-CRN's acquisition-level old-seed/new-seed decision plus a concrete failure regime for permanent seed reuse.
Kept the exact LUCB-H unknown-bias frontier open rather than over-generalizing adjacent safe-transfer results.

exact_next_action: Primary-verify PROBE's real-data stopping-time reduction and calibration overhead, then search for a sequential target-safe transfer method that learns source-target bias online with a finite-sample no-worse-than-target-only guarantee under deliberate bias-bound misspecification. If that remains absent, quantify a seed-reuse/new-seed switching statistic for KG-CRN-style stochastic BO and search non-Gaussian covariance-aware ranking/selection.
